title: Produced-dataset index (cached.toml) — spec-v3
description: JSON Schema for the JSON projection of a cached.toml produced-dataset index. Parse the TOML to JSON, then validate. spec-v3 adds the optional recipe `version` and `scope` (entry) and an optional declared default `scope` (_META).

scope.description: Optional declared default scope (the cached partition segment) for this file; else the derived project id.

entry.description: A produced dataset, addressed by portable key (cachetype + optional version + hash), never by absolute path.

version.description: Optional recipe/code version (a path segment when set).

scope.description: The cached partition segment for this artifact; defaults to _META.scope / the derived project id.

hash.description: Lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 of the canonical-JSON key table.
